events.verdict: Smith Jr. (HOU) makes contact with the ball as he and Reid (MIN) pursue the rebound.  Any ensuing contact to Reid's arm is considered incidental.
Thompson (HOU) establishes, and maintains, verticality as he absorbs the incidental body contact with Reid (MIN) during the layup attempt.
Sengun (HOU) establishes a screening position in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path and does not deliver illegal contact as he sets the pick.
VanVleet (HOU) brings his left hand forward and initiates contact with Edwards' (MIN) right forearm as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) is already in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Sengun (HOU) and Alexander-Walker (MIN) mutually engage and disengage with one another as they each move into the lane to establish rebounding position.
Reid (MIN) initiates contact with Sengun's (HOU) right arm and affects his put-back attempt.
Randle (MIN) and Smith Jr. (HOU) mutually engage and disengage with one another as they position themselves for the rebound.
McDaniels (MIN) brings his hands forward to Smith Jr.'s (HOU) side as he sets the pick and the contact is marginal prior to Smith Jr. stumbling on his own accord on the wing.
Randle (MIN) brings his right hand forward toward the ball and brushes Sengun's (HOU) right arm on the perimeter, which is marginal.
Sengun (HOU) lifts his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.
Sengun (HOU) brings his left arm towards Randle's (MIN) side, and the contact at the start of the drive is marginal.
Edwards (MIN) initiates contact across Sengun's (HOU) left arm and affects his driving shot attempt.
McDaniels (MIN) establishes a screening position in Tate's (HOU) path and does not deliver illegal contact as he sets the pick.
Edwards (MIN) avoids stepping out of bounds as he steps back toward the sideline.
Tate (HOU) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) is established in Sengun's (HOU) path and absorbs the marginal body contact after they come together during the drive.
McDaniels (MIN) cleanly deflects the ball as Sengun (HOU) releases the pass attempt in the post.
McDaniels (MIN) legally contest VanVleet's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) briefly grasps Smith Jr.'s (HOU) arm and immediately releases him as the ball ricochets toward the perimeter.
